item.title: Fast, reproducible NixOS virtual machines on macOS and Windows
item.description: One NixOS configuration, tuned virtual machines, and a consistent Linux environment across host operating systems.
item.content:encoded:
This post is being written.

I’ll cover how I structure the NixOS configuration, share it across machines, and tune the virtualization layer for good filesystem, networking, and CPU performance on both macOS and Windows.
item.author: Ebrahim Haghshenas

item.content:encoded:
